senses.gloss: m.(b. h.;קָרַשׁ; cmp. Arab.ḳarash collegit … et partes junxit) board.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 102b:3">Sabb. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ שנפלה וכ׳</he> a board attacked by a worm, v. <cite ref="D01111"><he>דַּרְנָא</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>קְרָשִׁים</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 52:4">Ex. R. s. 52</cite> <he>הרי ק׳ הרי וכ׳</he> here are the boards (for the Tabernacle), here are the bolts &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:3">Sabb. XII, 3</cite> <he>קַרְשֵׁי המשכן</he> the boards of the Tabernacle; a. fr.
